Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human C-C chemokine receptor type 2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter to standard_type IC50 and target name C-C chemokine receptor type 2. Require canonical_smiles is not null and pubmed_id or doi is not null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
